description: For every infinite cardinal k, membership in H_k is exactly hereditary cardinality below k, and H_k is a subset of V_k.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.HereditaryCardinality.hereditaryLevel_spec.{u} (κ : Cardinal.{u}) (hκ : Cardinal.aleph0 ≤ κ) :
  (∀ (x : ZFSet.{u}),
      x ∈ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.HereditaryCardinality.hereditaryLevel κ ↔
        Lemmatheca.SetTheory.HereditaryCardinality.HereditarilySmall κ x) ∧
    Lemmatheca.SetTheory.HereditaryCardinality.hereditaryLevel κ ⊆ ZFSet.vonNeumann κ.ord
